actions:
  Handle_files:
    meta: {}
    title: Handle files
    type: parallelGroup
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: >
      Parallel processing group that checks observable type and extracts file hash information if the observable is a file.
    actions:
      If_file:
        meta: {}
        title: If file
        type: conditional
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        description: >
          Checks if the observable type equals 'file' (case-insensitive) to determine if file hash extraction is needed.
        conditions:
        - action: Build_file_from_observable_metadata
          condition:
            $:and:
            - - $:ref: $inputs.observable.observable_type
              - $:eq: file
              - ignoreCase: true
        else: ""
      Build_file_from_observable_metadata:
        meta: {}
        title: Build file from observable metadata
        type: connector
        delay: 0
        pool: $default
        on-success:
        - Get_sha256: {}
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        description: >
          Constructs a file object from the observable metadata to enable hash extraction and file property analysis.
        action: $playbook.component_aUv23LOeaLVTNIjgQ_playbook
        asset: ""
        environment: {}
        inputs:
          file:
            $:ref: $inputs.observable.observable_metadata
        testInputs: {}
      Get_sha256:
        meta: {}
        title: Get sha256
        type: transformation
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        on-success:
        - update_observable_value_with_sha256: {}
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        description: >
          Extracts the SHA256 hash value from the file hashes array by filtering for hash_algorithm='sha256' and retrieving hash_value.
        transformations:
          sha256:
            title: sha256
            inputs:
              data:
                actions:
                  Build_file_from_observable_metadata:
                    result:
                      published:
                        file:
                          file_hashes:
                            $:ref: $actions.Build_file_from_observable_metadata.result.published.file.file_hashes
              expression: $arrayFilterBy(actions.Build_file_from_observable_metadata.result.published.file.file_hashes,'hash_algorithm','sha256') ~> $lookup('hash_value')
            next: ""
            description: ""
            display:
              functions:
              - function: arrayFilterBy
                inputs:
                - $:ref: $actions.Build_file_from_observable_metadata.result.published.file.file_hashes
                - hash_algorithm
                - sha256
              - function: lookup
                inputs:
                - hash_value
              advancedView: false
            timeout: 0
            meta: {}
            actionType: jsonata
        entrypoint: sha256
      update_observable_value_with_sha256:
        meta: {}
        title: update observable_value with sha256
        type: updateVariables
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        description: >
          Updates the observable_value variable with the extracted SHA256 hash to be returned as the component output.
        inputSchemaReferenceId: c6dc5ee9-3bf0-4d57-a218-aa2380563a6f
        outputSchemaReferenceId: 81b737d2-155c-4aca-b606-1eb9456762c0
        inputs:
        - name: observable_value
          operation:
            type: set
            value: '{ $:ref: $actions.Get_sha256.result.sha256 }'
    entrypoints:
    - If_file
  createVariables_ay7xk:

    on-success:
